opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members: undergraduate, Master’s and PhD students and postdoctoral scientists within six years of PhD viva (Scheme A includes undergraduates; Schemes B & C limited to PhD students and postdocs). Applicants must be UK‑based for conferences outside the UK, and must present a poster or talk.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at genetics‑related conferences (Society meetings, SIG meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences) with travel, accommodation or registration grants.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members can apply provided they are studying or working in the UK, or the training course is held in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative lab visits, covering travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration fees.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members can apply if they are studying or working in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation for field‑based genetics research projects, with awards up to £2,000 (typically below £1,700).

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of the age of the person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £60 per day to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings or events.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time to sponsor genetics‑themed meetings held in the UK or with strong UK links. Applications should be submitted at least three months before the event.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for genetics‑focused meetings not organised by the Society, with possible awards ranging from a few hundred pounds up to several thousand pounds.
